notes.title: Conquer the arrogant and pretty girls in Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790313/e75dd81e4905e1a27ac9399d377eb73dab4ff0f7.png[/img]

[b]Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels[/b] is a Tennis game with dynamic action-oriented gameplay. Control cute girls and compete in exciting matches with strategic positioning and masterful usage of special skills. Enjoy the hilarious story of how a retired Tennis coach regains his former glory.

[h2]Satisfying Tennis Gameplay[/h2]
Use a charged shot to hit the ball into perfect position on your opponent's field, or run up the net for intense close-quarter combat, taking the risk of a skillful lob from your opponent? Also, be mindful of your Stamina because you will be in serious trouble when it runs out. With enough Tension, unleash special skills and overwhelm your opponent. Test both your skill and your mind in this challenging game.

[h2]Train Your Girls[/h2]
Level up your characters to increase their stats and unlock new powerful skills to use in the match. Purchase suitable equipment to complement their playstyle. There are multiple characters with different stat growths and skills that you will need to unlock in Campaign Mode. Try out different characters and choose the one that suits your playstyle best.

[h2]Engaging Storyline[/h2]
For players that enjoy the game plot - we have many "plots" in this game (yes, both types of plots). Experience a fun and dramatic story in the role of an unwanted coach winning the approval (and hearts) of his beautiful female club members. Each character also has their own "Love Stories" that can be unlocked gradually as you train and level them up. Gotta catch... *cough* train them all!!!

[h2]Epic Tournament[/h2]
Bring your trained characters and participate in the epic Global Underground Tournament to see the results of their hard work. Compete against powerful opponents in the Tennis world. Can you come out on top and claim the title of Supreme Champion?

[b][h1]Follow us for more games![/h1][/b]

notes.title: Cute Suika: Big Watermelon has been officially released!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that Cute Suika: Big Watermelon is now officially released! 🎉🍉

We hope you have an amazing time playing our game. Your enjoyment means everything to us.

If you encounter any bugs or problems while playing, please let us know on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Nhaqy6HZAD]Discord channel[/url]. We are committed to providing the best experience possible and appreciate your feedback.

If you love the game, please consider leaving us a review on Steam. Your support and reviews help us tremendously in reaching more players and improving our game.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

Best regards,
Your Development Team
